text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year had begun, and starting this year, Narita Brian
would challenge races as a Senior-tier runner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "As I put together a schedule, pondering what kind of training we should organize compared to last year..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems something was thrown in through the window.
Turning toward the sound...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. One of the windows was open, so
I figured you might be here, but... hit the jackpot, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tossing that letter in was definitely the right move.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sitting under the kotatsu at home made me think of your face.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I dropped by on my way back from the gym.
Then I saw that your window was open.
So, you know what that means.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Come on, we don't have time. Let's get moving already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Here it comes!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the New Year's Special Exhibition Race!
Coming around the fourth corner, all 16 runners are packed into a single bunch!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Which girl will make a magnificent bloom at the start of the New Year?!
The frontrunner pulls away steadily, leaving the rest of the pack in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Go-o-o! Overtake them-m-m!!
Keep the lead to the end! Don't lose!
choice_data_list: A race right at New Year's...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What, got a problem with that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Look at the leader. That's some solid form.
At this rate... she's gonna push right through!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haha, how's that, just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I've taken care of everything.
I went to the gym, and I watched the match.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'd better head home soon, or my mom's gonna nag at me.
She'll start asking why I'm not relaxing during the New Year's break I was given.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Well, you just happened to be in the room,
so I suppose it was a stroke of luck we got to watch the race together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
In a few more days, regular classes and
training will start, and you'll see each other anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yet for some reason, this year I found myself
wanting to give you my greetings even earlier.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you again this year.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: Look forward to our training after New Year's!
I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.
I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: Look forward to our training after New Year's!
I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.
I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Right back at you.
See ya."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a light step,
Narita Brian set off in the direction of the station.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Yeah, you're right.
If it's your training, there's no doubting it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: To keep from getting rusty, I might as well run home too. The distance back to the ranch is...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hm. Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once I promised her that we'd train intensely
right after New Year's, Narita Brian
reluctantly agreed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
…………I'm not saying you need to
tense up or anything.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Still, I will hold out hope.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Just as you have high hopes for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, one thing led to another and we watched
just one more race together before heading home.
